$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and Apple HIG / UIKit style overrides for the Apple theme.

designMd.overview: Apple Human Interface Guidelines / UIKit system palette (`systemBlue`, `systemGroupedBackground`, `label`) with Retina 0.5px hairlines, per-size button corners (capsules only at large), continuous corners, and Liquid Glass on floating and raised surfaces.
designMd.elevation: Apple Liquid Glass and Retina hairline depth: `glass`, `menu`, and `raised` finishes request `material.apple` (`glass: "regular"`) with iOS backdrop fallback (`ios.backdrop`) and 0.5px borders; other surfaces stay flat with subtle shadows.
dos: Use the `button.corner.*` slots (5/6/8 with a pointer, `full` on touch) alongside `8px` controls/fields, `12px` containers, and `16px` modals with `shape.curve: "continuous"`.
Respect pointer (macOS: 13px body, 32px density row) vs touch (iOS: 17px body, 44px hit target) metrics.
Keep `material.apple` on `glass`, `menu`, and `raised` finishes and spread `platformMaterial()` on native views.
donts: Do not replace Retina `0.5px` `stroke.hairline` with thick borders or `circular` corners, and do not paint a selected control a solid accent: Apple washes it at 12%.
Do not set `macos.backdrop` when Liquid Glass `glassEffect` is active on macOS 26+.

radius.$description: Apple HIG corner radius scale (8px control, 12px container, 16px modal; button corners per size via the `button.corner.*` slots).

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

hairline.$description: Retina 0.5px hairline divider width per Apple HIG.

sm.$description: A small button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

md.$description: A regular button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

lg.$description: A large button's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

face.$description: The ground a chosen control turns over to: a toggle that is on, a tool that is picked, a button that is selected.

ink.$description: What a chosen control's label and glyph are drawn in.

face.$description: The ground of a secondary button: the ordinary visible action.

edge.$description: What a secondary button's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

hover.$description: The ground a secondary button turns over to under the pointer.

edge.$description: What a destructive button's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws none.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a secondary or destructive button wears, or `none` where it stands flat.

corner.$description: A badge's corner: the control radius, `full` for a capsule, or points.

color.$description: What a field's focus edge and ring are drawn in (`color:brand` for a crisp accent ring, `color:ring` for the theme's `focus.style` halo).

edge.$description: What a listbox option's focused border is drawn in (`color:brand@0.3`, `none`).

bar.$description: The surface a menubar frames its triggers on (`finish:card`, or `none` for a borderless transparent strip).

shade.$description: The finish whose elevation shadow a tooltip bubble wears, or `none`.

corner.$description: A choice's corner, per input: a quarter of its box where it is a square, half of it where it is a circle.

face.$description: The ground an unchosen box lies on.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade an unchosen box wears, or `none`.

track.$description: An off switch's track, per input: `[width, height]`.
A small switch's track, per input: `[width, height]`.

knob.$description: A small switch's knob, per input: side or `[width, height]`.

size.$description: An off switch's knob, per input: diameter or `[width, height]`.

off.$description: How thick an off switch's track edge is.

on.$description: How thick an on switch's track edge is.

color.$description: What an off switch's track edge is drawn in, or `none` where the track has no border.

rail.$description: A slider's rail, per input: its thickness.

band.$description: The band a slider keeps around its rail, per input.

size.$description: A slider's knob, per input: diameter or `[width, height]` (`0` where the theme draws only a mark).

pressed.$description: The knob size while pressed, per input, or `same` to keep the resting knob size.

edge.$description: What a solid slider knob's border is drawn in, or `none` where it wears only the knob finish's own edge.

shade.$description: The finish whose shade a slider's rail wears, or `none`.

width.$description: How thick a slider's rail edge is; `control` is the theme's `stroke.control`.

face.$description: The fill under a calendar's today, or `none` where it draws none.

ink.$description: What a calendar's today number is drawn in (`color:foreground`, `color:brand`).

spokes.$description: Whether an indeterminate spinner turns Apple's eight tapered rays instead of a turning arc.

opacity.$description: How faintly the spinner's groove shows, or `0` where it draws none.

edge.$description: What a sunk well's edge is drawn in, or `none` where it draws no border.

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (40% black).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities and press scale.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking; Apple dims via pressed-opacity).

disabled.$description: UIKit disabled content opacity multiplier (0.4); containers keep resting fills.
